{{Top|leg}}
'''Neurofibers''' were part of an [[Assembler]]'s biology. The microscopic neurofibers connected the Assembler to their web, as the web was an extension of the Assembler. The neurofibers also supplied the Assembler with nourishment. Any [[subnode]]s that the Assembler created were also connected to the web by neurofibers.<ref name="EGTAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>
